headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 1,991.5 Million Dollars From 2,523.1 Million As Gate Collapses
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to 1,991.5 million dollars, 0.7259 percent of the 274.4 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 2,523.1 million dollars. Gate's intake collapsed to 7.6 million dollars from 261.7 million dollars and Bitget fell to 597.2 million dollars from 917.6 million dollars, while Binance took in 1,331.4 million dollars, up from 1,283.4 million dollars. Coins are still arriving where holders can sell, and the remaining stream has narrowed onto Binance as Gate's arrival nearly vanished and OKX's outflow shrank to 52.9 million dollars from 121.4 million dollars.
author: jordan
